name: dpapi
description: DPAPI unsealing: unseal the task's base64 blob under the target user's own masterkeys and report the masterkey readiness facts -- collect.dpapi's execution half packed as the artifact an implant loads through module.load.

opsec.notes: Server side, the package lands as descriptor rows and one artifact file under the module store -- no code runs in the teamserver. On the target, the implant half loads from staged task content and nothing it does lands on disk: the blob arrives as task text, the plaintext rides back the task's channel into the audit chain. The unseal runs under the masterkeys of the user the implant runs as -- a blob sealed by another user or another machine refuses, and DPAPI itself keeps no operation log. The verb rides the per-engagement module load -- never a default profile.
